## Summary

fleet 7.4.0: every remaining open fleet task (step 3 of the goal) in one release, so the plugin is updated once. Plan: `docs/plans/fleet-step3-batch-7.4.0-2026-11-17.md`. Full list: `plugins/fleet/CHANGELOG.md` (7.4.0).

**Car 1:** network git calls lift the 1 GiB cap, so the credential helper no longer OOMs (#34). `push.py` does the push and the probe (#9 push redirect), and retires push_classify and push_probe. 6.3.2 review lows (#36).

**Car 2:** stricter db-prefix tests (#11). Hook-surface git calls pass `--ignore-submodules=none` (#13). Plain selected files under a dir hook path are allowed (#15, Max ruling; import-time and config files stay refused). `--opt=value` refs (#16a). The drift retry resets (#18). Read-only subcommand table (#20, ADR-1308). `hash_diff --allow` past the 50-key cap (#22).

**Car 3:** README stop gates, roles and threat model (#4, #28, #69 declined per ADR-1307, #17, #18). Session-project text (#23). Brief marker backstop (#30). policy_init temp-file leak (#31). tf_gate and changed_defs see submodule bumps. Control characters are stripped from logged paths.

**Car 4:** R4 hook-input gaps (#29). npm walk-up plan guard (#39 part 2). The session warning is limited to worktrees.

**Car 5:** #64, #66, #68, #70 (items 1, 2, 4). The `--if-present` skip takes only exact forms (security). npx walk-up guard.

**Car 6:**
- Plan-mode gate sweep (#60 step 3).
- Test conflicts route to the judge. An unattended re-plan with an open PR pushes to that PR, never with force (#61, ADR-1306).
- Planner and audit rules (#26, #45, #46).
- uv env (#73, from the daneel session). Greenfield `pyproject.toml` route (#72). Ordinal phrases are not test claims (#64 item 2).

**Review fixes** (two adversarial opus reviews, plus automated security reviews):
- push.py pushes to the sealed URL with an explicit refspec (no `+`). It refuses local, worktree and command-scope transport config (remote.*, http.*, credential.*, ssh.*, core.sshCommand, core.gitProxy). It checks parent, tree and origin head itself. The #61 PR head comes from the script.
- A new pyproject's pytest table goes through an allowlist (keys and addopts). A coder test conflict is capped, and unattended runs ask before that re-plan.
- Every diff-tree is submodule-aware. A `.gitmodules` ignore key is refused.
- The npm guard keys on the root script. The plan sweep runs only for planned gate files and warns when it does not finish. The push keeps time back for the head read. The uv cache is split into a writer tier and a gate tier.

**Known limits:**
- Under the 100-agent cap, the #61 open-PR rebuild finishes only from a resumed run: one run stops at `cap` before the commit, and the PR stays untouched.
- `cargo clippy/test`, `go vet` and `ruff check` local hooks still stop at the freeze (ADR-1308).

**Tests:** 2016/2016 pass (`node --test 'plugins/fleet/tests/*.test.mjs'`). `build-workflow.mjs --check` and `gen.mjs --check` pass. The dist is 465,052 bytes of the 480,000 guard.

**Follow-ups filed:** #71 (remaining R4 gaps), and pr_test_block false-positive claims. Manual: #19, #25, #31 P7/P8/T5/T6, #17 real-tool check. Split out: #1, #6, #7 (v1.1 gates), #62 (cost).
